title: Nanorobot queue: Cooperative treatment of cancer based on team member communication and image processing
abstract: arXiv:2111.11236v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Although nanorobots have been used as clinical prescriptions for work such as gastroscopy, and even photoacoustic tomography technology has been proposed to control nanorobots to deliver drugs at designated delivery points in real time, and there are cases of eliminating "superbacteria" in blood through nanorobots, most technologies are immature, either with low efficiency or low accuracy, Either it can not be mass produced, so the most effective way to treat cancer diseases at this stage is through chemotherapy and radiotherapy. Patients are suffering and can not be cured. Therefore, this paper proposes an ideal model of a treatment method that can completely cure cancer, a cooperative treatment method based on nano robot queue through team member communication and computer vision image classification (target detection).

translated_title: 纳米机器人队列：基于团队成员通信与图像处理的癌症协同治疗方法
translated_abstract: 尽管纳米机器人已被应用于胃镜检查等临床工作，甚至已有光声层析成像技术被提出用于实时控制纳米机器人在指定投放点投放药物，也有通过纳米机器人清除血液中“超级细菌”的案例，但大多数技术尚不成熟，要么效率低、要么精度低，要么无法批量生产，因此现阶段治疗癌症最有效的方式仍是化疗和放疗，患者承受着痛苦且无法被治愈。为此，本文提出了一种能够彻底治愈癌症的治疗方法的理想模型，即通过团队成员通信和计算机视觉图像分类（目标检测）实现的基于纳米机器人队列的协同治疗方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于纳米机器人队列的理想癌症治疗模型，通过团队成员通信与计算机视觉目标检测技术实现纳米机器人的协同治疗，以期彻底治愈癌症。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an ideal cancer treatment model based on nanorobot queues, achieving cooperative cancer treatment through team member communication and computer vision-based target detection.
